memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, drives auto-rickshaw, manages household chores.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 10 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular; polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Reports occasional worry, GAD-7 score 8 (mild anxiety).
carers: Ravi, husband.
goals: "I want to keep working and stay breathless-free."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
escitalopram 5 mg OD
buspirone 5 mg BD
allopurinol 100 mg OD
febuxostat 40 mg OD
tiotropium inhaler OD
salbutamol inhaler SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4-4.0)
Haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (12-16)
Serum uric acid 7.2 mg/dL (<7.0)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling more anxious lately, especially during traffic jams. Worried about missing fares. Using buspirone as needed but still tense.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Continues driving auto-rickshaw, reports mild dyspnea on steep roads.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (stable).
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait slightly slow on uneven ground; timed up-and-go 11 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular; polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Increased anxiety, GAD-7 score 12 (moderate).
carers: Ravi, husband.
goals: "I need better breath control to keep working longer shifts."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
escitalopram 10 mg OD
buspirone 5 mg BD
allopurinol 100 mg OD
febuxostat 40 mg OD
colchicine 0.5 mg BD PRN for gout flare
tiotropium inhaler OD
salbutamol inhaler SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 2.0 mIU/L (0.4-4.0)
Haemoglobin 13.0 g/dL (12-16)
Serum uric acid 6.8 mg/dL (<7.0)
Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.5-1.1)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Chest X-ray: lungs hyperinflated, flattened diaphragms, no acute infiltrate. Consistent with COPD, no new pathology.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to Pulmonology for COPD optimisation and inhaler technique review. Include recent spirometry request.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pulmonology reviewed: advised to continue tiotropium and budesonide-formoterol, add pulmonary rehab referral. Spirometry shows FEV1 55% predicted, FEV1/FVC 0.58.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Manages household, drives shorter routes due to breathlessness.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (borderline); plan for full MoCA.
falls: One fall at home slipping on wet floor, no injury; gait cautious; timed up-and-go 13 seconds – raised fall risk, advise exercise and supportive footwear.
medicines: 6 regular; polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Anxiety improved, GAD-7 score 7 (mild).
carers: Ravi, husband.
goals: "I want to stay steady on my feet and avoid another fall."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
escitalopram 10 mg OD
buspirone 5 mg BD
allopurinol 200 mg OD
febuxostat stopped
colchicine 0.5 mg BD PRN
tiotropium inhaler OD
salbutamol inhaler SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD

memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-02-15 10:00 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) for routine follow‑up.

falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular; polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Stable, GAD-7 score 6 (mild).
carers: Ravi, husband.
goals: "I wish to keep working and stay healthy for my family."
